# Diff.rsd, which sets the pipeline's IR against the translated IR. Replay of a row: plant it in a copy of the tree, build the compiler
# of that copy (the native compiler's `--store S --home COPY t.rsd`), run `lean --run instruments/lrc-host/Sides.rsd S/build/rsc-native 40`; the row is
# caught when that exits 1.
# The guard of a child read inside a call translated in place, without the depth of that call (recatb: an integer field, child 7).

FROM: items := xs.items ++ [mkGuard (i.toNat + 1 + cx.inlOn.length) mkUnreachable,
TO: items := xs.items ++ [mkGuard (i.toNat + 1) mkUnreachable,

# FILE: # lib/lrc/Emit.rsd, which Diff.rsd never runs (the port audit r1, R2): a guard that lets the last refused budget pass, and a call that
# hands its callee one unit of fuel too many.
lib/lrc/Emit.rsd
FROM: let guard := lg em.fuel ++ i64Const n.b ++ wLeU ++ wIf ++ emRefuse em.conv profile.tagFuel profile.detNone ++ wEnd
TO: let guard := lg em.fuel ++ i64Const n.b ++ wLtU ++ wIf ++ emRefuse em.conv profile.tagFuel profile.detNone ++ wEnd

# FILE: lib/lrc/Emit.rsd
FROM: lg 0 ++ (if same || isOwnFn em.nImg f then lg em.fuel else lg em.fuel ++ i64Const (1 + depth : Nat) ++ wSub)
TO: lg 0 ++ (if same || isOwnFn em.nImg f then lg em.fuel else lg em.fuel ++ i64Const (depth : Nat) ++ wSub)

# FILE: # lib/lrc/Emit.rsd, a wrong value with the same status: a product that is the square of its left operand. Shown by the rows whose VALUE
# is read back from a module, not by the statuses alone.
lib/lrc/Emit.rsd

TO: else if p == primMul then codeOk (emMul em.conv a a d)

# FILE: # rsc/rsc.rsd, the refusal's code as the compiler prints it (the row litlong): the function left out; the residue's code replaced by the
# present lowering's code for a bad body.
rsc/rsc.rsd
FROM: lrcRefusedBase + ((Lrc.refusalClass e * 1000 + (if Lrc.refusalFn e < 1000 then Lrc.refusalFn e else 999) : Nat) : Int)
TO: lrcRefusedBase + ((Lrc.refusalClass e * 1000 : Nat) : Int)

# FILE: rsc/rsc.rsd
FROM: | Except.error e => outFail (lrcRefused e)
TO: | Except.error _ => outFail profile.cBody

# FILE: # Rows 8 to 17, the arrays' runtime and the boundary's entry (lib/lrc/Emit.rsd "Arrays", `emitFns`): the read of an element one
# word off, a push in place that does not count its element, a copy that does not count the elements it shares (seen when the copy
# is dropped and the first array read again: row arrkeep), a list cell with the list in the place of its head, a list counted
# twice (row arrof), a slice of one element more, a large cell taken from the list of another capacity (row arrbig), the public entry that runs
# the function and not its twin (the values then are the stage's own forms), a write in place one word off, and an array of
# objects not taken for an array. Each is shown by the value the reader of instruments/lrc-host/Sides.rsd reads from the stage's module.
# Not rows, and why: a count that is not taken back, an element that is not released, or a large cell freed onto a list no
# allocation reads, in these functions leaves cells live and changes no value; the module keeps no count of live cells, so
# nothing here sees such a leak.
lib/lrc/Emit.rsd

TO: codeOk (lg a ++ lg b ++ i64Const 3 ++ wShl ++ wAdd ++ wWrap ++ i64LoadAt 16 ++ ls d ++ (if imm == 0 then [] else wIncLoc d em.t0))

# then makes no word and the join point reads none.

# FILE: # Object fields of four bytes (rsc's layer `narrow`; lib/lrc/Emit.rsd "The width of an object field"). Sides.rsd runs every row's
# module of narrow fields against the stage's module, so each of these is caught there and nowhere else: a field read as 8 bytes
# whatever its width; a field written as 8 bytes; an index of a field counted in steps of 8 bytes (the release of an object, a write
# at an index in a variable, a list cell's tail); a word of the scalar area read, and one written, where it stands after fields of 8
# bytes; the fields of a new object written 8 bytes apart; the number of an integer's word read without its sign; the list cells that
# an array's elements become, each said to have one object field (row 31; since a scalar head is an object word there, lib/lrc/FromWire.rsd
# "A scalar head where an object field is four bytes", every cell has two); a list's heads read into an array, a scalar's as an
# object's and an object's as a scalar's (row 32); and the module of narrow fields without the export that says so (the reader then
# reads fields of 8).
# Not a row: the word of an integer below zero left with its upper 32 bits (`primBoxS` without its mask). A field keeps the low half
# whatever stands above it, and every reader of an integer's word in a variable takes the number out of the low half with its sign, so
# no run shows the difference; the mask is there so that the word in a variable is the word a field gives back.
lib/lrc/Emit.rsd
FROM: def fldLoad (fw off : Nat) : List Int := if fw == 4 then wLoad32 off else i64LoadAt (off : Int)
TO: def fldLoad (fw off : Nat) : List Int := if fw == 0 then wLoad32 off else i64LoadAt (off : Int)

# FILE: lib/lrc/Emit.rsd

TO: def fldStore (fw off : Nat) : List Int := if fw == 0 then wStore32 off else i64StoreAt (off : Int)

# FILE: lib/lrc/Emit.rsd

TO: def fldShift (fw : Nat) : Int := if fw == 0 then 2 else 3

# bytes read as two; one written as a byte; a field of two bytes written as a byte; and a constructor's scalar area sized
# without its fields of four bytes, so that its last fields are written past the cell (the interpreter keeps no bytes and
# cannot show that one). The fields exist under the layer `narrow` only, so the third module of a row is where each shows.

# so Sides.rsd alone sees it): the callee counting the caller's fuel down and not its own; entered with one unit of fuel
# too many; its entry's test refusing nothing; a `ret` that leaves its values on the stack and not in the variables the
# call binds; and the regions of a caller beginning inside the caller's own locals. Rows: inl, inlempty (ProgInl.rsd),

# inside a fold's body is refused, rsdc_type), so no row has the shape.
lib/lrc/Emit.rsd
